subject: prd/argus-ledger-lint
statement: When a ledger-touching change is gated with a merge base present, the history arm shall report a defect if any previously-merged `A-n` or `E-n` entry is edited or removed — its body, anchor, numbering, or presence changed relative to the merge base.
rationale: append-only-ness is a git-history property no per-file check can see (F-2); DINV-1/DINV-2 are declared absolute but unenforced
fit_criterion: on the edited-`A-n`, edited-`E-n`, renumbered-entry, and deleted-entry fixtures, the history arm reports a defect naming the ledger and the disturbed entry; each is red at the history arm only
